summary: The CryoSPARC workflow processed 20 movies through motion correction and CTF estimation, resulting in 20 micrographs. Blob picking identified 27,621 particles using a diameter of 150.0 angstroms, though the denoising step reported zero micrographs processed.

key_results.interpretation: Total number of movies imported into the project.
Number of micrographs successfully processed through motion correction and CTF estimation.
Total number of particles identified by the blob picker.
The diameter setting used for particle picking.
Number of micrographs processed by the Janni denoiser.

next_steps: Perform 2D classification to filter the 27,621 picked particles for high-quality classes.
Investigate the micrograph denoiser configuration as it failed to process any micrographs.
Proceed to ab-initio reconstruction once a clean particle stack is generated.
caveats: The micrograph denoiser step (Janni) reported 0 micrographs processed, suggesting it may have been skipped or misconfigured.
The analysis is based on a very small initial dataset of 20 movies.
